# Tiki Turtle Cafe

> A vocational training cafe in Hilo, Hawaii, serving plate lunch, sandwiches,
> salads and Dole Whip. Every meal is prepared by individuals with disabilities
> building real culinary and customer-service job skills. A program of The Arc
> of Hilo. Tagline: "Where Every Bite Transforms Lives."

## Visit
- Address: 1099 Waianuenue Ave, Hilo, HI 96720
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM (closed weekends)
- Phone: 808-935-8534
- Email: info@tikiturtlehi.com
- Website: https://tikiturtlehi.com
- Order online: https://www.clover.com/online-ordering/the-tiki-turtle-cafe-hilo

## What we serve
- Daily rotating plate-lunch specials, Monday to Friday, roughly $12 to $17
- Taco Tuesday: Tacos, Rice & Beans
- Kalua Nachos on Wednesdays
- Signature sandwiches (Chicken Mac Nut Pesto, Da Robert's Special, Chicken Bacon Ranch)
- Deli sandwiches with a choice of bread, protein, side and toppings
- Signature salads with housemade dressings
- Smoothies (16 oz) and Dole Whip soft-serve, with a new flavor each week
  plus pineapple and vanilla daily
- Bowls are available for some meals on request

## Pricing note
Prices shown on the website are cash prices. Card payments add 4 percent.

## Mission and impact
Tiki Turtle Cafe is operated by The Arc of Hilo, which has served the Big
Island community for over 70 years and supports 220+ families. The cafe opened
in August 2023 and provides paid, real-world culinary and customer-service
training to individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities.

Verified figures since opening (from point-of-sale records, Aug 2023 to Mar 2026):
- $425,000+ earned through the team's work
- 23,500+ meals made
- 3 years serving Hilo

## August 2026: "3 Years of Aloha"
The cafe's third birthday. Month-long celebration including Double Taco Week
(Aug 18 and 20), LauLau collaborations with Kimo & Melia's (Aug 10 and 24),
a $3 Dole Whip Follow Day (Aug 11), and the Birthday Bash Finale on Tuesday
Aug 25 with cake and a live grand-prize drawing.

## Catering
Available for meetings, parties and community events. Enquire through the
website contact form or by phone.
